visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair tied in a low ponytail stands in an indoor room, wearing a white V-neck shirt. She gestures with her hands while speaking directly to the camera. A lush green plant in a white pot sits on a shelf directly above her head against a plain beige wall. The lighting is bright and professional. (2) A close-up shot shows a colorful baby walker with hanging toys. A baby's small hand reaches out to touch a blue and orange spinning ball hanging from the arch. The background shows a light-colored wooden floor. (3) The baby, with short dark hair, lies on his stomach on a patterned play mat. He uses his right hand to press large, glowing pastel-colored piano keys on the toy, which light up in orange. (4) The baby stands on the wooden floor wearing a striped t-shirt and denim overalls. He holds onto the handle of the walker for support while an adult's hand is visible behind him helping him balance. (5) Transition back to the woman speaking; she holds up two fingers to emphasize a point. The indoor setting remains consistent. (6) A baby gym with a circus-themed mat is shown. The infant lies on his back under a plastic arch containing mirrors and colorful spinning car toys. (7) The woman speaks again, now holding up three fingers. Her expression is helpful and engaging. (8) A hand interacts with a wooden pop-up toy; pressing a red mushroom button makes a blue bear head pop up. The baby is seen crawling nearby on a grey play mat. (9) The woman holds up four fingers while speaking. (10) A wooden zig-zag car ramp toy is displayed. A small toy car slides down the teal and white tracks. The baby lies on the floor watching the car move. (11) A wooden toy with three colored balls is shown. A hand hammers a blue ball through a hole, causing it to fall onto a colorful xylophone below and roll out. (12) The woman concludes her message with a friendly smile and a small wave of her hand.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 最近很多人問我. (2) [Slogan]: 怎麼幫小孩挑玩具. (3) [Subtitle]: 其實挑對玩具. (4) [Subtitle]: 真的很蠻重要的. (5) [Slogan]: 手部跟腦部的發展都有顯著的進步. (6) [Subtitle]: 特別是美國這邊. (7) [Subtitle]: 醫生會注重小孩的. (8) [Subtitle]: 腦部發展. (9) [Subtitle]: 如果沒有達標的話. (10) [Subtitle]: 就會被開作業. (11) [Slogan]: 所以一定要買到適合的玩具. (12) [Slogan]: 第一名 Titi 琴. (13) [Subtitle]: 這個真的超實用. (14) [Subtitle]: 小時候躺著會玩. (15) [Subtitle]: 上面的玩具. (16) [Subtitle]: 長大之後可以. (17) [Subtitle]: 坐著玩琴鍵. (18) [Subtitle]: 再更大一點可以. (19) [Subtitle]: 推著走練習. (20) [Slogan]: 第二名 Yookidoo 健力架. (21) [Subtitle]: 這是我們寶寶小時候. (22) [Subtitle]: 唯一一個願意玩的玩具. (23) [Subtitle]: 車車會自己動. (24) [Subtitle]: 而且非常的耐操. (25) [Subtitle]: 我們很多時候就是. (26) [Slogan]: 靠這個才可以好好吃飯. (27) [Slogan]: 第三名 Cause and Effect Toy. (28) [Subtitle]: 這有很多不同的廠牌啦. (29) [Subtitle]: 但是可以讓寶寶學習到. (30) [Subtitle]: 按一個按鈕. (31) [Subtitle]: 東西就會打開. (32) [Subtitle]: 幫助他的腦部發展. (33) [Subtitle]: 也可以鍛鍊. (34) [Subtitle]: 手部的精細動作. (35) [Slogan]: 第四種我覺得很值得買的. (36) [Slogan]: 球球或車車. (37) [Subtitle]: 因為它們會. (38) [Subtitle]: 隨著重力往下掉. (39) [Subtitle]: 會幫助寶寶學習到. (40) [Subtitle]: 東西有掉下去的概念. (41) [Subtitle]: 這個車車玩具. (42) [Subtitle]: 我們寶寶很喜歡玩. (43) [Slogan]: 隨著小車車飛奔而去. (44) [Subtitle]: 除此之外呢. (45) [Subtitle]: 還有這個木頭鋼琴. (46) [Subtitle]: 我覺得超棒. (47) [Subtitle]: 因為球掉下去. (48) [Subtitle]: 會發出聲音. (49) [Subtitle]: 可以吸引寶寶的注意力. (50) [Subtitle]: 玩很久很久喔.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female voice speaks in Mandarin with clear articulation. A cheerful, upbeat acoustic guitar track plays in the background at a moderate tempo. (2) The narration continues alongside a sequence of four ascending synthesized piano notes (C, D, E, F) from a toy. (3) A soft mechanical whirring sound like a small motor or geared toy is heard, mixed with the ongoing voice and BGM. (4) The vocal delivery becomes slightly more animated. A sharp, plastic clicking sound occurs, immediately followed by a soft 'boing' or pop effect as a toy part springs up. (5) The narration maintains its instructional tone. A series of rapid percussive wooden clacks (tack-tack-tack) mimics the sound of a toy car sliding down a ramp. (6) Distinct metallic chime sounds ring out in a C-D-E sequence as a ball strikes xylophone keys, followed by the muffled thud of a ball rolling onto a floor. (7) The female voice concludes the segment with a pleasant, rising goodbye inflection as the guitar music gently fades out.
